claude-multi-desktop

Several Claude Desktop accounts at once on one Mac. Separate sign-ins, one shared Claude Code setup, and sessions that message each other across accounts.

Claude Main
account A · own sign-in
Claude Work
account B · own sign-in
Claude Personal
account C · own sign-in
one shared ~/.claude: skills · CLAUDE.md · memory · MCP servers · sessions
One bash script · MIT · github.com/jackson-cmd/claude-multi-desktop
